title: Matt’s fabulous tour!
text: Matt was a fantastic guide on a rainy day! Equipped with a wonderful van, offering umbrellas to those not equipped, he easily navigated between narratives in Spanish and English for a group of seven. We learned so much in three hours about a beautiful city.. I would definitely use Matt again as a guide!
author: 801chucks

title: Anatoli as a fuide
text: We spent all day with Anatoli exploring Barcelona.  He was a wealth of information and so engaging. He introduced us to new foods and places throughout the city.   He was so much fun!

title: Best tour ever!
text: Carlos was amazing, we learned so much and saw so many sights! We will definitely be rebooking soon. We ate a delicious meal and had good wine as well. Very good experience.
author: izabellar636

title: Montse
text: Had a wonderful day with our tour guide , Montse. Very knowledgeable about everything. Sagrada Familia, the Olympic area. Just a great time.
author: Kevin M

title: Go with Teo!
text: Teo is a very good guide. He explained the importance and history of Barcelona and its culture. He gave us great advice on things to do and where to find good restaurants.
author: flatsdad

title: Wonderful 1/ day tour with exceptional tour guide Teo
text: Our 1/2 day tour of Gothic Quarter and Segrada Familia was just wonderful. Well planned, on time, very informative and friendly. Our tour guide Teo was excellent. Smart, great English, calm and patient with everyone.
author: Odyssey57007981783

title: TEO was a terrific guide Sagrada Família and Walking Old Town
text: TEO picked me, my mom and my young adult daughter up at our hotel and was a terrific guide and very sweet. We walked the old town, drove to some other sites and ended at Sagrada Familia. Note that our tour did not include a guided tour of inside Sagrada Familia but it was not needed as the museum in the basement teaches so much and the inside space is so beautiful, it is nice to just sit and absorb the magical light from the stained glass windows.
author: meljelinek

title: Will recommend our tour guide Teo and this tour as an intro to Barcelona
text: Teo is very informative, very accommodating and fun. I would recommend the tour. Our group is lively and not boring. Was able to go to some places that’s not part of the tour. I really appreciate Teo as a tour guide. Went above and beyond.
author: jennytp18

title: Great tour, would highly recommend.
text: My wife and I had a great experience with our guide, Daniella.  She navigated us around Barcelona showing us the main attractions, as well as some lesser known gems.  She recommended a great restaurant for lunch.  We had a great time.  Would highly recommend.
author: Steve_S
